# Per Day

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [Terminology](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#PerDay)*

If a rule says you can use something a certain number of times per day, that means you must finish a [Long Rest](../Exploration/Long-Rest.md) to use it again after you run out of uses.
